meta.title: Sending only a new start time is silently ignored
gaps: The plan cannot assert that the response is specifically HTTP 422 beyond the expected rejection code.
The plan cannot compare the round start time with its exact pre-request value; it only verifies that it remains before a far-future epoch timestamp.
the case reads as “it is accepted”, but the plan checks “it is refused”
warnings: error code 2 is not in en-IN.yml (or the backend checkout is missing) — the message cannot be checked

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer updates the event with the bid start time moved later.
As the buyer, read the pricing round and check that “starting from” is at most 9999999999.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with a clear message, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: “starting from” is at most 9999999999.
